notes: Immediate strict read of the same Editable predicate as Strider actions and expectations: enabled, not read-only, and a text/settable input, textarea or contenteditable element. Unsupported kinds return false, including selects, checkboxes and ARIA-only textboxes; Playwright accepts more kinds and throws for unsupported elements. Native readOnly and the element’s exact aria-readonly="true" prevent editing; aria-disabled="true" on any ancestor disables it. Hidden/inert elements may read true. NoMatch and StrictViolation fail immediately; no attachment wait. Uses the existing owned read path, including frame targets, access release and operation deadlines. Locators resolve afresh rather than retain ElementHandle identity. Contenteditable follows native isContentEditable; WebKit may report false for hidden or inert contenteditable elements.

audit.scope: Shared engine predicate inspected; cross-browser rules, strictness, frame targets, released access and deadline regression coverage.

decision.quote: Unsupported kinds return false so callers can branch on the predicate without handling a type error.
